parameters.jsCode:
// PA-05: deterministic pattern_id (same identity across reruns → upsert, no dupes)
const input = $input.first().json;
const RESEARCH_VERSION = 'RESEARCH-R000001';
const rows = (input.results || []).map(r => ({
  pattern_id: 'PAT-' + r.symbol + '-' + r.timeframe + '-' + r.pattern_definition_hash,
  status: r.status,
  timeframe: r.timeframe,
  market: r.symbol,
  conditions: JSON.stringify({ key: r.pattern_key, direction: r.direction, feature_version: r.feature_version }),
  evidence: JSON.stringify({ cycle: input.cycle_id, is_stats: r.is_stats, oos_stats: r.oos_stats, oos_stats_gross: r.oos_stats_gross, wf_positive: r.wf_positive_windows + '/' + r.wf_windows, p_value: r.p_value, bh_rejected: r.bh_rejected }),
  sample_size: r.sample_size_is,
  occurrences: r.sample_size_is,
  win_rate: r.oos_win_rate,
  duration_minutes: 15,
  fees_slippage_adjusted: r.oos_net_return,
  mae: null,
  mfe: null,
  failure_cases: r.failure_cases || null,
  market_regime: (r.status === 'REGIME_ROBUST_CANDIDATE' ? 'multi:' : 'is:') + input.regime_is + '|oos:' + input.regime_oos,
  validity_period: null,
  research_version: RESEARCH_VERSION,
  return_distribution: JSON.stringify(r.oos_stats || null),
  gross_return: r.oos_stats_gross ? r.oos_stats_gross.mean : null,
  slippage: r.slippage_cost,
  net_return: r.oos_net_return,
  profit_factor: r.oos_stats ? r.oos_stats.profit_factor : null,
  max_drawdown: null,
  failure_rate: r.oos_stats ? 1 - r.oos_stats.win_rate : null,
  validation_version: input.validation_version,
  regime_breakdown: JSON.stringify({ regime_is: input.regime_is, regime_oos: input.regime_oos, regime_limited: r.status !== 'REGIME_ROBUST_CANDIDATE' }),
  cycle_id: input.cycle_id,
  // new hardening columns
  pattern_definition_hash: r.pattern_definition_hash,
  split_info: input.split_info,
  oos_win_rate: r.oos_win_rate,
  oos_net_return: r.oos_net_return,
  oos_sample_size: r.oos_sample_size,
  fee_cost: r.fee_cost,
  slippage_cost: r.slippage_cost,
  slippage_bps: r.slippage_bps,
  slippage_model: r.slippage_model,
  wf_results: r.wf_results,
  wf_version: 'WF-V1-' + r.wf_windows + 'win',
  hypothesis_id: r.hypothesis_id,
  parameters_hash: r.pattern_definition_hash,
  minimum_sample: r.minimum_sample,
  multiple_testing_method: r.multiple_testing_method,
  p_value: r.p_value,
  bh_rejected: r.bh_rejected,
  cross_asset_status: r.cross_asset_status,
  evidence_label: r.evidence_label,
  evidence_score: r.evidence_score,
  data_quality_report: input.data_quality_report,
}));
if (!rows.length) return [{ json: { _none: 'yes' } }];
return rows.map(r => ({ json: r }));
